characters.summary: Rayman is a limbless hero who relies on acrobatic movement, helicopter-like hair hovering, and throwing his detachable fists as ranged energy punches. He can also use various magical powers and physical combat techniques acquired across his adventures.

mechanisms: Health restoration via Lums or hearts

weaknesses: Vulnerable to hazards such as water/drowning in early titles
limitations: Cannot sustain permanent flight, only helicopter gliding/hovering
Fists must return before striking again

sources.supports: Basic summary, powers, history, and limbless physiology.

feats.claim: Uses his telescopic fist to strike enemies from a distance.
Spins his hair to hover and cross large gaps.

notableResults.note: Defeated the primary antagonist to save the Electoons.

campaignTags.claim: Rayman uses his hair as a helicopter to glide and slow his descent.

unknowns: Exact limits of his magical transformations in spinoffs versus core platformers.

characters.summary: Reinhardt Wilhelm is a heavily armored crusader who uses a massive rocket hammer for devastating close-range melee strikes and a large energy barrier shield to protect allies. He can also propel himself forward in a rapid charge to pin enemies against walls.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to attacks from behind when his barrier is deployed
Large target with limited ranged offense outside of Fire Strike
limitations: Barrier Field has a finite health pool and breaks under heavy fire
Charge locks him into a linear path

sources.supports: Reinhardt's general abilities, weapon loadout, and crusader role.

feats.claim: Slams the ground with Earthshatter, knocking down all enemies in a cone in front of him.
Charges forward to pin an enemy and crash them into a wall.

campaignTags.claim: Launches a flaming projectile wave via Fire Strike.

unknowns: Exact durability limits of his Crusader armor against high-end sci-fi weaponry.

characters.summary: Ryu is a dedicated martial artist who travels the world to test his skills, utilizing traditional Ansatsuken karate techniques. He fights using projectile energy blasts (Hadoken), upper-cut anti-airs (Shoryuken), and forward-advancing kicks (Tatsumaki Senpukyaku).
weaknesses: Vulnerable to zoning and overwhelming psychic or magical attacks
limitations: Relies on physical stamina and spiritual focus
Projectile attacks require brief startup motions

sources.supports: Ryu's background, Ansatsuken fighting style, and signature moves like Hadoken and Shoryuken.

feats.claim: Projects concentrated spiritual energy as a Hadoken projectile.
Executes a rising flaming dragon punch (Shoryuken) to defeat opponents.

notableResults.note: Won the first World Warrior tournament final, though scarred Sagat in the process.

unknowns: The full extent of his spiritual potential without succumbing to the Satsui no Hado.

characters.summary: Evil Ryu is the form Ryu takes when consumed by the Satsui no Hado, trading emotional control and defense for vastly amplified offensive power, speed, and lethal dark ki techniques.
weaknesses: Mental instability and self-destructive reliance on dark energy
Lower defensive resilience than base Ryu
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard disciplined moves with murderous dark ki variants, including the Raging Demon and teleportation dashes.

sources.supports: Evil Ryu persona, Satsui no Hado corruption, and altered moveset.

unknowns: Whether Evil Ryu can permanently maintain this form without completely destroying his own body.

characters.summary: This form represents Ryu having mastered the Mu no Ken (Power of Nothingness), allowing him to counter the Satsui no Hado with supreme inner peace, clarity, and devastating enlightened spiritual attacks.
weaknesses: Requires extreme mental discipline to maintain
characters.formDifferences: Replaces dark ki with enlightened spiritual energy (Mu no Ken), granting immunity to the Satsui no Hado and enhanced luminous attacks.

sources.supports: Mu no Ken mastery and enlightened state surpassing Evil Ryu.

campaignTags.claim: Channels concentrated electrical energy through Denjin techniques.

unknowns: Upper limits of the Power of Nothingness against cosmic-level threats.

characters.summary: Sam Fisher is a master covert ops operative specializing in stealth, infiltration, close-quarters combat, and the tactical use of high-tech gadgets and night vision equipment.
weaknesses: Vulnerable if caught in open combat against heavily armed or superhuman foes
limitations: Physical strength is peak human rather than superhuman

sources.supports: Sam Fisher's background as a Third Echelon agent, stealth tactics, and gadget usage.

feats.claim: Infiltrates heavily guarded enemy compounds undetected.
Eliminates multiple targets in rapid succession using Mark and Execute.

campaignTags.claim: Employs advanced stealth tactics, shadows, and concealment.
Uses night vision goggles, cameras, and specialized tactical gear.
Operates as a black-ops infiltration specialist.

unknowns: Effectiveness against supernatural or highly magical entities.

characters.summary: Samus Aran is a galactic bounty hunter equipped with Chozo-derived powered armor featuring an arm cannon that fires energy beams, missiles, and the ability to morph into a small spherical bomb-dropping shape.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to extreme parasitic drains (like Metroids) without specific suit upgrades
Limited defense if armor is severely compromised
limitations: Requires energy refills and ammunition pickups for missiles
Certain environments require specific suit upgrades to survive

sources.supports: Samus Aran's Power Suit, arm cannon, Morph Ball, and bounty hunter capabilities.

feats.claim: Destroys entire planetary ecosystems and alien fortresses single-handedly.
Tanks massive energy blasts and physical impacts within her Power Suit.

notableResults.note: Defeated the Zebesian leader with assistance from the infant Metroid.

campaignTags.claim: Performs high-speed aerial spins and Space Jump maneuvers.
Uses Morph Ball, bombs, and grappling beams.

unknowns: Full extent of her Chozo-infused DNA capabilities outside of her suit.

characters.summary: Equipped with the Gravity Suit upgrade, Samus gains immunity to environmental movement penalties in liquids like water or lava, alongside a major reduction in damage taken from enemy attacks.
weaknesses: Still vulnerable to specialized corruption agents like Phazon without further upgrades
characters.formDifferences: Reduces damage taken by half and eliminates water/liquid movement friction compared to the standard Power Suit.

sources.supports: Gravity Suit properties granting resistance and fluid movement underwater.

campaignTags.claim: Operates fully submerged without movement hindrance.

unknowns: Exact thermal threshold in extreme magmas.

characters.summary: In her Metroid Suit form, Samus manifests organic Metroid traits across her armor, granting her the ability to drain life energy directly from foes and neutralize dangerous X Parasites.
weaknesses: Instability of raw Metroid DNA urges
Vulnerable to extreme cold if traditional Metroid weaknesses apply
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard suit aesthetic with organic Metroid elements and grants energy-draining melee capabilities.

sources.supports: Metroid Suit acquisition and energy-draining powers in Metroid Dread.

campaignTags.claim: Drains life force from enemies to sustain herself.

unknowns: Long-term mental and physical consequences of full Metroid transformation.

characters.summary: Empowered by radioactive Phazon corruption, Samus wears the Phazon Suit which grants total immunity to blue Phazon hazards and unleashes devastating hyper-mode energy attacks.
weaknesses: Risk of corruption overtaking Samus if Hyper Mode is overused
characters.formDifferences: Changes suit coloration to dark blue/black and grants immunity to Phazon hazards along with the lethal Phazon Beam.

sources.supports: Phazon Suit attributes and Phazon beam weaponry in Metroid Prime.

feats.claim: Absorbs concentrated Phazon energy to overload enemy targets.

conditional.dependsOn: Exposure to or storage of Phazon energy

unknowns: Complete permanence of Phazon corruption after the destruction of Phaaze.
